# Columns of the `m.reference` datasets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

In a session with `unknown_symbols=dm.UnknownSymbols.WARN` (or `MASSIVE_UNKNOWN_SYMBOLS=warn`), `m.reference.tickers`, `m.reference.ticker_details`, `m.reference.related_companies`, and `m.snapshots` also have a `RawSymbol` String column, which holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. The tables below show the default session, without it.

<a id="tickers"></a>

## `m.reference.tickers`

Every ticker Massive supports, across asset classes, with its listing details.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under." | REST | `ticker` |
| `Active` | boolean | Whether or not the asset is actively traded. False means the asset has been delisted. | REST | `active` |
| `BaseCurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST | `base_currency_name` |
| `BaseCurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is priced against. | REST | `base_currency_symbol` |
| `Cik` | String | The CIK number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Index_Key). | REST | `cik` |
| `CompositeFigi` | String | The composite OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST | `composite_figi` |
| `CurrencyName` | String | The name of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST | `currency_name` |
| `CurrencySymbol` | String | The ISO 4217 code of the currency that this asset is traded with. | REST | `currency_symbol` |
| `DelistedUtc` | Instant | The last date that the asset was traded. | REST | `delisted_utc` |
| `LastUpdatedUtc` | Instant | The information is accurate up to this time. | REST | `last_updated_utc` |
| `Locale` | String | The locale of the asset. | REST | `locale` |
| `Market` | String | The market type of the asset. | REST | `market` |
| `Name` | String | The name of the asset. For stocks/equities this will be the companies registered name. For crypto/fx this will be the name of the currency or coin pair. | REST | `name` |
| `PrimaryExchange` | String | The ISO code of the primary listing exchange for this asset. | REST | `primary_exchange` |
| `ShareClassFigi` | String | The share Class OpenFIGI number for this ticker. Find more information here (https://www.openfigi.com/about/figi) | REST | `share_class_figi` |
| `Type` | String | The type of the asset. Find the types that we support via our Ticker Types API (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/tickers/ticker-types). | REST | `type` |

| `SicDescription` | String | A description of this ticker's SIC code. | REST | `sic_description` |

## `m.reference.related_companies`

The companies Massive relates to a ticker, from news and returns data, one row each.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "A ticker related to the requested ticker." | REST | `ticker` |

## `m.reference.conditions`

The trade and quote condition codes, with what each means and how it updates bars.

| `UpdateRulesConsolidatedUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. | REST | `update_rules.consolidated.updates_volume` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesHighLow` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the high/low. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_high_low` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesOpenClose` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the open/close. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_open_close` |
| `UpdateRulesMarketCenterUpdatesVolume` | boolean | Whether or not trades with this condition update the volume. | REST | `update_rules.market_center.updates_volume` |

<a id="snapshots"></a>

## `m.snapshots`

The current state of tickers of any asset classes, from Massive's unified snapshot.

Called as `m.snapshots`, a method of the session itself rather than of `m.reference`; its catalog record is `reference.snapshots`, so its columns are documented on this page.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. REST `ticker`: "The ticker symbol for the asset." | REST | `ticker` |
| `BreakEvenPrice` | double | The price of the underlying asset for the contract to break even. For a call, this value is (strike price + premium paid). For a put, this value is (strike price - premium paid). | REST | `break_even_price` |
| `DetailsContractType` | String | The type of contract. Can be "put", "call", or in some rare cases, "other". | REST | `details.contract_type` |
| `DetailsExerciseStyle` | String | The exercise style of this contract. See this link (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Option_style) for more details on exercise styles. | REST | `details.exercise_style` |
| `DetailsExpirationDate` | LocalDate | The contract's expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format. | REST | `details.expiration_date` |
| `DetailsSharesPerContract` | double | The number of shares per contract for this contract. | REST | `details.shares_per_contract` |
| `DetailsStrikePrice` | double | The strike price of the option contract. | REST | `details.strike_price` |
| `Error` | String | The error while looking for this ticker. | REST | `error` |
| `Fmv` | double | Fair Market Value is only available on Business plans. It is our proprietary algorithm to generate a real-time, accurate, fair market value of a tradable security. For more information, contact us (https://massive.com/contact). | REST | `fmv` |
| `FmvLastUpdated` | Instant | If Fair Market Value (FMV) is available, this field is the nanosecond timestamp of the last FMV calculation. | REST | `fmv_last_updated` |
| `GreeksDelta` | double | The change in the option's price per $0.01 increment in the price of the underlying asset. | REST | `greeks.delta` |
| `GreeksGamma` | double | The change in delta per $0.01 change in the price of the underlying asset. | REST | `greeks.gamma` |
| `GreeksTheta` | double | The change in the option's price per day. | REST | `greeks.theta` |
| `GreeksVega` | double | The change in the option's price per 1% increment in volatility. | REST | `greeks.vega` |
| `ImpliedVolatility` | double | The market's forecast for the volatility of the underlying asset, based on this option's current price. | REST | `implied_volatility` |
| `LastMinuteClose` | double | The closing value for the minute aggreate. | REST | `last_minute.close` |
| `LastMinuteDecimalVolume` | String | The trading volume for the minute aggregate with decimal precision. This field provides support for fractional shares, representing volume as a decimal string where the fractional part is expressed in millionths. This field is only returned for stocks snapshots. | REST | `last_minute.decimal_volume` |
| `LastMinuteHigh` | double | The highest value for the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.high` |
| `LastMinuteLow` | double | The lowest value for the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.low` |
| `LastMinuteOpen` | double | The open value for the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.open` |
| `LastMinuteTransactions` | long | The number of transactions that took place within the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.transactions` |
| `LastMinuteVolume` | double | The trading volume for the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.volume` |
| `LastMinuteVwap` | double | The trading volume weighted average price for the minute aggregate. | REST | `last_minute.vwap` |
| `LastQuoteAsk` | double | The ask price. | REST | `last_quote.ask` |
| `LastQuoteAskExchange` | long | The ask side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST | `last_quote.ask_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteAskSize` | double | The ask size. This represents the number of shares, or contracts for options, sellers are offering at the given ask price. | REST | `last_quote.ask_size` |
| `LastQuoteBid` | double | The bid price. | REST | `last_quote.bid` |
| `LastQuoteBidExchange` | long | The bid side exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST | `last_quote.bid_exchange` |
| `LastQuoteBidSize` | double | The bid size. This represents the number of shares, or contracts for options, buyers are bidding for at the given bid price. | REST | `last_quote.bid_size` |
| `LastQuoteLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_quote.last_updated` |
| `LastQuoteMidpoint` | double | The average of the bid and ask price. | REST | `last_quote.midpoint` |
| `LastQuoteTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `last_quote.timeframe` |
| `LastTradeConditions` | int[] | A list of condition codes. The codes depend on the asset type; see the condition codes for stocks (https://massive.com/docs/rest/stocks/market-operations/condition-codes), options (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes), or crypto (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/condition-codes). | REST | `last_trade.conditions` |
| `LastTradeDecimalSize` | String | The size of a trade, including fractional shares, represented as a decimal string where the fractional part is expressed in millionths. This field is only returned for stocks snapshots. | REST | `last_trade.decimal_size` |

| `LastTradeLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_trade.last_updated` |
| `LastTradeParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was generated at the exchange. | REST | `last_trade.participant_timestamp` |
| `LastTradePrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. A trade of 100 shares with a price of $2.00 would be worth a total dollar value of $200.00. | REST | `last_trade.price` |
| `LastTradeSipTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it. | REST | `last_trade.sip_timestamp` |
| `LastTradeSize` | long | The size of a trade (also known as volume). | REST | `last_trade.size` |
| `LastTradeTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `last_trade.timeframe` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `MarketStatus` | String | The market status for the market that trades this ticker. Possible values for stocks, options, crypto, and forex snapshots are open, closed, early_trading, or late_trading. Possible values for indices snapshots are regular_trading, closed, early_trading, and late_trading. | REST | `market_status` |
| `Message` | String | The error message while looking for this ticker. | REST | `message` |
| `Name` | String | The name of this contract. | REST | `name` |
| `OpenInterest` | double | The quantity of this contract held at the end of the last trading day. | REST | `open_interest` |
| `SessionChange` | double | The value of the price change for the asset from the previous trading day. | REST | `session.change` |

| `SessionDecimalVolume` | String | The trading volume for the asset for the day with decimal precision. This field provides support for fractional shares, representing volume as a decimal string. This field is only returned for stocks snapshots. | REST | `session.decimal_volume` |

| `SessionHigh` | double | The highest price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.high` |
| `SessionLateTradingChange` | double | Today's late trading change amount, difference between price and today's close if in late trading hours, otherwise difference between last price during late trading and today's close. | REST | `session.late_trading_change` |
| `SessionLateTradingChangePercent` | double | Today's late trading change as a percentage. | REST | `session.late_trading_change_percent` |
| `SessionLow` | double | The lowest price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.low` |
| `SessionOpen` | double | The open price of the asset for the day. | REST | `session.open` |
| `SessionPreviousClose` | double | The closing price of the asset for the previous trading day. This is the correct field for the prior session's reference price, and it is retained across the daily session rollover. It is absent only for an asset with no completed prior session, such as a newly listed ticker or option contract. | REST | `session.previous_close` |
| `SessionPrice` | double | The price of the most recent trade or bid price for this asset. | REST | `session.price` |
| `SessionRegularTradingChange` | double | Today's change in regular trading hours, difference between current price and previous trading day's close, otherwise difference between today's close and previous day's close. | REST | `session.regular_trading_change` |
| `SessionRegularTradingChangePercent` | double | Today's regular trading change as a percentage. | REST | `session.regular_trading_change_percent` |
| `SessionVolume` | double | The trading volume for the asset for the day. A value of 0 means no trades have occurred yet in the current session. | REST | `session.volume` |
| `Timeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `timeframe` |
| `Type` | String | The asset class for this ticker. | REST | `type` |
| `UnderlyingAssetChangeToBreakEven` | double | The change in price for the contract to break even. | REST | `underlying_asset.change_to_break_even` |
| `UnderlyingAssetLastUpdated` | Instant | The nanosecond timestamp of when this information was updated. | REST | `underlying_asset.last_updated` |
| `UnderlyingAssetPrice` | double | The price of the trade. This is the actual dollar value per whole share of this trade. A trade of 100 shares with a price of $2.00 would be worth a total dollar value of $200.00. | REST | `underlying_asset.price` |
| `UnderlyingAssetTicker` | String | The ticker symbol for the contract's underlying asset. | REST | `underlying_asset.ticker` |
| `UnderlyingAssetTimeframe` | String | The time relevance of the data. | REST | `underlying_asset.timeframe` |
| `UnderlyingAssetValue` | double | The value of the underlying index. | REST | `underlying_asset.value` |
| `Value` | double | Value of Index. | REST | `value` |
